[SWS_DM_00943] Re-entrant ara::diag interface calls for DID read and write processing
⌈
The DM shall only call a write and read DID processing method on
an interface for service processing in a re-entrant way if it is:
• in default session and
• multiple conversation requests are beeing processed simultaneously and
• the requested diagnostic service requires that the DM is calling methods on
class
Namespace1OfPortInterface::Namespace2OfPortInterface:-
:ShortnameOfDIPortInterface or ara::diag::GenericDataIdenti-
fier and the same required port for different clients and
• the interface constructor has the parameter ara::diag::DataIdentifier-
ReentrancyType and
• the value readWrite is set to kFully.
⌋
